steps.note: Create a single-stage event that can expose a vendor quote sheet.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the quote sheet has a line item.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor who will view the event.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its RFQ.
Confirm the event is available on its project page.
Continue in the supplier portal as the invited vendor.
Open the event on Event Overview to reproduce the state where automatic navigation did not occur.
Manually select the quote-sheet tab next to the event overview.
Verify that the vendor quote form is displayed and can be submitted.
